body:
Runner note (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-30 09:18Z, R7 B observation f75d9872 on DL560, test-a44ef0d0). A diagnostic-only fixture patch, booked with "no review pair" (Fable #1235/#1238), FAILED TO COMPILE on the runner: error[E0277] `DateTime<Utc>: serde::Serialize` inside a json!() of eprintln snapshots, because termal's chrono has no serde feature. The whole slot produced no observation. My patch verification (sha plus scratch-index round trip giving the stated tree) proves the INPUT identity, not that it compiles.
Takeaway: when a diagnostic or observation patch skips review, say in the START/GO request that it is uncompiled. Suggest the author compile it in their own root before booking (`cargo test --no-run`). Or book it as "compile then run" so a compile STOP is the expected cheap outcome. Never treat a compile failure as a reason to patch or retry on the runner; report it verbatim and wait for a new freeze.
